candidate.derivedAnswer: D. No, because they are coplanar
candidate.answerReason: Combinations of vectors in one plane remain in that plane, so they cannot represent every vector in space and cannot form a spatial basis.

methods.label: Apply the spatial basis requirement
methods.explanation: Three coplanar vectors cannot uniquely represent every vector in space.
methods.levelReason: Uses the representation requirement in the school fundamental theorem of vectors in space.
